scope: Lesson 1-2 and 3-4 connected courtyard ground assets only; no runtime source or original v1 file changed.

request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent modular environment sprite for an illustrated children's English learning journey map.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing Lesson 1–2 garden courtyard platform. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the already-approved continuous cream-stone paths, coral arches and lush greenery journey environment. Do not copy its whole map or its water/background.
Primary request: EDIT Image 1 into an open, connected garden courtyard section that is part of a continuous walking journey, not a closed circular isolated island. Keep the existing central courtyard floor, original large coral arch at upper rear, flower beds, cypress trees and quality/palette/light consistent.
Composition and exact invariants: output a 1536 by 1024 landscape 3:2 canvas with a genuinely transparent background. Keep the existing broad usable cream paved character standing area at normalized x 0.23–0.77 and y 0.56–0.75 clear, flat and in the same place and perspective. Do not shift this central standing area. Keep the original large rear arch and trees. Only open the side enclosure and add attached paths: a cream-stone path enters from the left rear edge at (0.03,0.40), joins the courtyard's left side at (0.22,0.60); another cream path leaves the right front side at (0.78,0.70), runs to the right canvas edge at (0.98,0.78). These should visibly be a continuous walkable stone terrace, with openings in the corresponding low walls, not thin floating strips. Coral masonry arches and low walls beneath the side paths, small flowering foliage where paths merge, as in reference Image 2. Keep foreground face low enough that the central floor remains visually open.
Style: high-finish soft storybook 3D illustration, cream limestone paving, warm salmon/coral masonry, sculpted rounded green foliage, tiny white and yellow flowers, warm upper-left sunlight, clean detailed edges. Match the existing design rather than redesign it.
Transparent output: only the courtyard, arch, paths, masonry and plants; real alpha everywhere outside these objects, including arch holes. No black matte, no opaque backdrop, no colored atmospheric halo.
No humans, no characters, no faces, no text, no signs, no letters, no numbers, no stars, no medals, no icons, no UI, no sky, no sea, no river, no large landscape background, no detached island, no extra building.
